holmesConsistency: Holmes is clearly the same man in nearly every image, in both styles: gaunt, hollow-cheeked, high-foreheaded, with slicked-back black hair, a sharp nose and thin lips. That consistent face is itself a recognisable Peter Cushing likeness; only in a few small or turned-away views (h011, h014, h015, h024, h027) does it fall back to a generic lean Victorian type.
